Good western dishes
Feb 2024 • Couples
We had lunch at Chickita and enjoyed our meal. 

The boneless chicken breast was cooked well and was juicy. It was served with our choice of 8 sauces none of which was special. Corn was delicious as a side. The sweet potato fries were good but unlike any that I have had in the United States. 

The restaurant was clean and the prices are certainly reasonable. 

I would recommend Chickita if you get tired of Asian dishes and you are desperate for a western meal.
